mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_shipment (shipment_no, outbound_id, carrier, tracking_no, shipped_at, operator, remark) VALUES (#{shipmentNo}, #{outboundId}, #{carrier}, #{trackingNo}, now(), #{operator}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, shipment_no AS shipmentNo, outbound_id AS outboundId, carrier AS carrier, tracking_no AS trackingNo, shipped_at AS shippedAt, operator AS operator, remark AS remark FROM wms_shipment WHERE outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY id
